This is a test run of using Quarto and practicing in-line coding.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

#Load Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguin_data <- penguins
```

The dataset contains observations of `r n_distinct(penguin_data$species)` species of penguin. In the dataset, `r nrow(penguin_data)` individual penguins across the `r n_distinct(penguin_data$island)` islands were recorded.
